SELECT c.CODE, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.GOAL, c.POINT_EARNED, c.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, c.DELETE_YN, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.PROGRESS_STATUS, c.POST_STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT,
c.ADM_CODE AS ADMIN_CODE, a.EMP_ID AS ADMIN_ID, a.ROLE AS ADMIN_ROLE,
( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.MEM_CODE) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND ce.STATUS IN ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL ) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = c.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'challenge' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMBNAIL,
( SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN ce.MEM_CODE END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ce.MEM_CODE), 0), 1 ), 0 ) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND ce.STATUS IN ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL ) AS ACHIEVEMENT_RATE
FROM CHALLENGE c
LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT a ON a.CODE = c.ADM_CODE
WHERE c.CODE = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.MEM_CODE) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce

SELECT p.MEM_CODE AS MEMBER_CODE, m.ID AS MEMBER_ID, p.STATUS, p.JOINED_AT
FROM (
SELECT ce.MEM_CODE,
CASE WHEN MAX( CASE WHEN ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 1 THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'JOINED' END AS STATUS,
MIN(ce.JOINED_AT) AS JOINED_AT
FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce
GROUP BY ce.MEM_CODE
ORDER BY JOINED_AT DESC, ce.MEM_CODE DESC LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset} ) p
LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = p.MEM_CODE
ORDER BY p.JOINED_AT DESC, p.MEM_CODE DESC

SELECT ce.MEM_CODE, MIN(ce.JOINED_AT) AS FIRST_JOINED_AT
FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce
WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = #{code}
GROUP BY ce.MEM_CODE

SELECT CASE WHEN p.FIRST_JOINED_AT >= #{todayStart} THEN 'TODAY' ELSE 'YESTERDAY' END AS DAY_TYPE,
HOUR(p.FIRST_JOINED_AT) AS HOUR_OF_DAY,
COUNT(*) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT
FROM (
) p
WHERE p.FIRST_JOINED_AT >= #{yesterdayStart} AND p.FIRST_JOINED_AT < #{now}
GROUP BY DAY_TYPE, HOUR_OF_DAY
ORDER BY DAY_TYPE, HOUR_OF_DAY

WITH
participants AS ( SELECT ce.MEM_CODE, MIN(ce.JOINED_AT) AS JOINED_AT
FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce
GROUP BY ce.MEM_CODE ),
eligible_proofs AS ( SELECT f.CODE, f.MEM_CODE, DATE(f.CREATED_AT) AS PROOF_DATE, COALESCE(f.HITCOUNT, 0) AS VIEW_COUNT
FROM FEED f
JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = f.CHAL_CODE
JOIN participants p ON p.MEM_CODE = f.MEM_CODE
WHERE f.CHAL_CODE = #{code} AND f.DELETE_YN = 0
AND f.CREATED_AT >= c.START_DATE AND f.CREATED_AT < c.END_DATE
AND f.CREATED_AT >= p.JOINED_AT
AND f.CREATED_AT < #{now} ),
proof_likes AS ( SELECT fl.FEED_CODE, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT
FROM FEED_LIKE fl
JOIN eligible_proofs ep ON ep.CODE = fl.FEED_CODE
WHERE fl.DELETE_YN = 0
GROUP BY fl.FEED_CODE ),
scored_proofs AS ( SELECT ep.CODE, ep.MEM_CODE, ep.PROOF_DATE, ep.VIEW_COUNT, COALESCE(pl.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT,
( CAST(ep.VIEW_COUNT AS SIGNED) + COALESCE(pl.LIKE_COUNT, 0) * 10 ) AS SCORE
FROM eligible_proofs ep
LEFT JOIN proof_likes pl ON pl.FEED_CODE = ep.CODE ),
daily_candidates AS ( SELECT sp.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sp.MEM_CODE, sp.PROOF_DATE
ORDER BY sp.SCORE DESC, sp.CODE ASC ) AS DAILY_ORDER
FROM scored_proofs sp ),
member_scores AS ( SELECT dc.MEM_CODE,
SUM(dc.VIEW_COUNT) AS SCORED_VIEW_COUNT, SUM(dc.LIKE_COUNT) AS SCORED_LIKE_COUNT, SUM(dc.SCORE) AS TOTAL_SCORE
FROM daily_candidates dc
WHERE dc.DAILY_ORDER = 1
GROUP BY dc.MEM_CODE ),
proof_stats AS ( SELECT ep.MEM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS PROOF_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT ep.PROOF_DATE) AS PROOF_DAYS
FROM eligible_proofs ep
GROUP BY ep.MEM_CODE ),
challenge_days AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN END_DATE > START_DATE THEN DATEDIFF( DATE(DATE_SUB(END_DATE, INTERVAL 1 SECOND)), DATE(START_DATE) ) + 1 ELSE NULL END AS GOAL_DAYS
FROM CHALLENGE
WHERE CODE = #{code} ),
member_totals AS ( SELECT p.MEM_CODE,
COALESCE(ps.PROOF_COUNT, 0) AS PROOF_COUNT, COALESCE(ps.PROOF_DAYS, 0) AS PROOF_DAYS,
COALESCE(ms.SCORED_VIEW_COUNT, 0) AS SCORED_VIEW_COUNT, COALESCE(ms.SCORED_LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS SCORED_LIKE_COUNT, COALESCE(ms.TOTAL_SCORE, 0) AS TOTAL_SCORE
FROM participants p
LEFT JOIN proof_stats ps ON ps.MEM_CODE = p.MEM_CODE
LEFT JOIN member_scores ms ON ms.MEM_CODE = p.MEM_CODE ),
ranked AS ( SELECT mt.*,
RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY mt.TOTAL_SCORE DESC, mt.PROOF_DAYS DESC ) AS RANK_NO
FROM member_totals mt )
SELECT r.RANK_NO, r.MEM_CODE AS MEMBER_CODE, m.ID AS MEMBER_ID,
( SELECT i.PATH
FROM IMAGES i
WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = r.MEM_CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0
ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS PROFILE_IMAGE,
r.PROOF_COUNT, r.PROOF_DAYS, r.SCORED_VIEW_COUNT, r.SCORED_LIKE_COUNT, r.TOTAL_SCORE,
ROUND( LEAST( 100.0, 100.0 * r.PROOF_DAYS / NULLIF(cd.GOAL_DAYS, 0) ), 1 ) AS ACHIEVEMENT_RATE
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = r.MEM_CODE
CROSS JOIN challenge_days cd
ORDER BY r.RANK_NO ASC, r.MEM_CODE ASC
LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset}
